    Optimized for Remote Installations

    The Lenovo ThinkSystem SR250 V3 powered by the next-generation Intel® Xeon® E-2400/6300-series processors provide higher workload performance at an entry-level price point. Designed to the same standards as all ThinkSystem servers, the SR250 V3 brings high-reliability and security to any IT infrastructure.

     

    The SR250 V3 also offers the latest DDR5 memory, PCIe 5.0, and GPU support for modern workloads like extending AI inferencing to remote installations, virtualization, and business applications.

    Agile and Easy to Manage

    The ThinkSystem SR250 V3 provides flexible storage options with multiple types ranging from mid-sized to large capacity. They also have hot-swap and simple swap options depending on your needs. The SR250 V3 have up to 2x PCIe slots to help tailor configurations to meet your needs.

     

    The SR250 V3 includes the Lenovo XClarity Controller, that standardizes and automates server management tasks. It shares common options with the ThinkSystem portfolio enabling easier management across the entire IT infrastructure. XClarity also helps speed deployment.

    High Value per Performance

    The SR250 V3 has the price per performance ideal for growing businesses. It brings high value to your IT infrastructure with the Intel® Xeon® E-2400/6300-series and support for the latest technology like DDR5 memory and PCIe Gen5 which provides the speed and performance necessary to support virtualization and business applications.

     

    Adding to the value performance, the SR250 V3 supports up to 8 core performance with no more than 95W CPUs, making it powerful, yet energy efficient. This is very important for clients who are running edge applications in a non-traditional data center setting.

    Tech Specs
    Form Factor

    1U rack; height: 43mm (1.7 inches), width: 435mm (17.1 inches), depth: 498mm (19.6 inches)

    Processor

    1x Intel® Xeon® E-2400/6300-series processor, up to 8 cores at 95W

    Memory
    • Up to 128GB in 4x UDIMM slots, max 128GB
    • TruDDR5 memory 4400 ECC (16Gb/32GB)
    Disk Bay Combinations
    • 4x 3.5″ simple/hot-swap SATA
    • 2x 3.5″ simple swap SATA + 2x 3.5″ simple-swap NVMe (G4)
    • 8x 2.5″ hot-swap SATA/SAS/SSD
    • 10x 2.5″ hot-swap SATA/SAS/SSD
    • 1 x Internal USB Port (Type A)
    • Optional 2 x M.2 kit (SATA, in PCIe slots)
    PCIe
    • 1x PCIe Gen5 x16 slot OR 2x PCIe Gen4 x8 slots
    • One x8 slimline (PCIe Gen4) connector to support CFF RAID or two simple-swap NVMe SSD
    RAID Support

    Support HW RAID (share with ThinkSystem Option)

    Network Interface

    2x 1 GbE Embedded; 1x 1GbE Dedicated Management

    Ports
    • Front: 1x USB 2.0, support XCC mobile; 1x USB 3.0 (Up to 5Gps), Optional front VGA port
    • Rear: USB 3.2 Gen 1x1 Ports, up to 5Gb/s; 1x Serial COM Port; 1x VGA Port
    Systems Management and Security
    • ROT module with integrated PFR, BMC, TPM, and EEPROMs
    • ThinkSystem XClarity Controller
    Power Supplies
    • Support fixed PSU 300W; Dual Redundant AC CPRS PSU;
    • Redundant CRPS Titanium PSU can meet ErP lot 9
    OS Support

    Microsoft Windows Server 2022, Red Hat, SUSE, and VMware ESXi. Visit lenovopress.com/osig for more information

    Limited Warranty

    1-year or 3-year warranty with the option to upgrade to years 4 & 5
